parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Singularity image or URI from which to create the container.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command to be run in the container. (templated)

parameters.name: start_command
parameters.description: Start command to pass to the container instance.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Environment variables to set in the container. (templated)

parameters.name: working_dir
parameters.description: Set a working directory for the instance.

parameters.name: force_pull
parameters.description: Pull the image on every run. Default is False.

parameters.name: volumes
parameters.description: List of volumes to mount into the container, e.g. ``['/host/path:/container/path', '/host/path2:/container/path2']``.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Other flags (list) to provide to the instance start.

parameters.name: auto_remove
parameters.description: Delete the container when the process exits. The default is False.
